about_the_game:
Experience the solitude of a small desert town lost in time with these 23 tracks. Melancholy, anxiety, anguish, and hope—this music accompanies you throughout your entire emotional journey as you explore Rue Valley, meet its residents, learn about their problems, and face your own demons.

Composed by Ana Krstajić.
